recent_posts.title: The Long-Term Cost of Technical Debt & How to Avoid It
recent_posts.summary: Technical debt is an unseen cost that can negatively impact software performance, development speed, and profitability. Taking quick shortcuts may provide immediate benefits but can lead to significant long-term drawbacks. Mitigating technical debt through clean code practices, iterative development, and regular assessments can enhance system efficiency and support scalability. Strategic technical debt during prototyping or meeting deadlines can sometimes be justified, provided there's a plan for repayment.

recent_posts.title: Avoiding Technical Debt: Best Practices for Sustainable Digital Development
recent_posts.summary: Technical debt arises from short-term solutions that compromise long-term code quality and stability. It can hinder innovation, increase maintenance costs, and affect scaling abilities. To avoid technical debt, prioritize scalable architecture, code quality, automation through CI/CD pipelines, and regular refactoring. Keeping dependencies updated and documenting code effectively can further help in managing technical debt, ensuring your digital product remains sustainable and future-proof.

recent_posts.title: Elixir Success Story: Clarus R+D Rebuilds Smarter
recent_posts.summary: Clarus R+D faced performance issues and technical debt with their original tech stack built in PHP and React. They decided to rewrite their app using Elixir, resulting in significant improvements in performance and flexibility. The new platform allowed for faster calculations, a more responsive user interface, and smoother internal processes. These changes helped the company adapt quickly to client needs and ultimately facilitated a successful acquisition due to a reliable, scalable product foundation.
